title: Lou P Probable NDE 3335
content:
The Final Harvest Has Begun: Spirit Children Having a Human Experience (The Principe Collection) (Volume 1) Check it out at: Click Here After a car accident where the car was so mangled they thought I was dead, they heard me moan. I was placed in traction for weeks in Englewood Hospital. My neck and back were injured and I was coughing up blood. I had an out of body experience. It wasn't during an operation, it was while I was in traction. I floated out of my body to the top of the room and then I floated into the hallway down to over the nurse's station and I could hear them speaking. I was very, very scared and yelling at the top of my lungs, 'HELP! HELP!' but they couldn't hear me. The next thing I knew, I was back in my body.

After a car accident where the car was so mangled they thought I was dead, they heard me moan. I was placed in traction for weeks in Englewood Hospital. My neck and back were injured and I was coughing up blood. I had an out of body experience. It wasn't during an operation, it was while I was in traction. I floated out of my body to the top of the room and then I floated into the hallway down to over the nurse's station and I could hear them speaking. I was very, very scared and yelling at the top of my lungs, 'HELP! HELP!' but they couldn't hear me. The next thing I knew, I was back in my body.

elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control

elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes The spirit does live outside the body and continues on. We can't see x-rays, radio waves, gamma rays, but we know they exist. At the moment of death, the body gets lighter. It is my belief at that exact moment, the physical body is dead, but the spirit exits. At the same moment of death, the four candlepower of light we generate goes out and a fine mist leaves the body. That to me is the spirit moving into another dimension. I just finished a book titled 'God's Spirit Children Having a Human Experience'. It's based on my experience.
